title: Cloud [tier_policy] ladder so Jev's classification changes what a cloud tick runs
description: Follow-up from ms9. The cloud (.tick/runners.cloud.toml) declares no [tier_policy], so every cloud dispatch runs at tier "" and the Jev classification each tick pays for changes nothing. The local ladder routes P(design)+P(diagnosis) > 0.75 to frontier since ms9. The cloud needs a two-rung Workers AI ladder, and the operator has to choose it: (a) keep glm-5.3 as the start (default=strong) and add a stronger dear/ceiling rung (frontier). pi's Workers AI catalog carries moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code and deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro-0813, and neither has been proven in the container image; image/common.sh pi_model_overrides corrects only GLM. Or (b) economy=glm-5.3-flash start -> strong=glm-5.3 dear. Both models are proven, but about 80% of cloud ticks would then start on flash, and Phase 2 saw flash converge on 1 of 3 real ticks. Once chosen: declare [tier_policy] (default, ceiling, dear_work_types=[design,diagnosis], dear_tier, mass_threshold=0.75) plus the tier cells, add SubstrateCloud to jevRoutedSubstrates in internal/runconfig/repoconfig_test.go, and prove a cloud boot of the new model through the harness probe.
notes: 2026-09-30 14:16 - Operator decision 2026-09-30: option B. The cloud [tier_policy] ladder (.tick/runners.cloud.toml) starts on GLM 5.3 Flash (economy) and the dear rung and ceiling are GLM 5.3 (strong), both Workers AI through pi and already proven in the container image, so the cloud rule holds. The mass rule mirrors ms9's local one: P(design)+P(diagnosis) > 0.75 starts at strong; everything else and every unclassified tick starts on Flash. step = 2, so a failed Flash attempt climbs straight to GLM 5.3 and stops there (balanced is not a declared rung). Role jobs are never classified and resolve GLM 5.3 at every tier. The dear-rung harness probe needs no new boot: GLM 5.3 is the model every cloud implement/review/closeout dispatch has run so far. Accepted risk: Phase 2 saw Flash finish 1 of 3 real ticks, and most cloud ticks now start there. Escalation is the safety net. Revisit (a stronger dear rung, or strong as the start) if the recorded economy->strong escalation rate is high. Tests: SubstrateCloud joins jevRoutedSubstrates (TestRepoRunnersConfigRoutesTheFirstAttemptOnJevMass/cloud), and the new TestRepoRunnersConfigCloudLadderIsFlashToGLM covers it; TestRepoRunnersConfigKeepsClaudeOffTheCloud and the reconcile cloud-rule tests stay green.
acceptance_criteria: runners.cloud.toml declares a Workers AI-only ladder the operator chose; TestRepoRunnersConfigRoutesTheFirstAttemptOnJevMass covers the cloud; a cloud boot on the dear rung passes the harness probe
closed_reason: cloud [tier_policy] declared: GLM 5.3 Flash start, GLM 5.3 dear rung/ceiling, mass threshold 0.75 (operator option B)
